Preserve explicit audit fields, exact decimal statistics, source byte identities, and selected scope. Remove full origins, source-manifest listings, native/process/owner identities and file inode metadata. Convert admission parent identities to boolean relationships and active transport roster to a count. No token digest or private original PID is copied.

New English public narrative of the frozen independent audit. Preserve findings, exact timing and qualification limits while omitting raw owner/process identities and private source listings. The original audited artifacts remain unchanged and are identified by their source SHA-256 values.

Copy only the original baseline-warmup final.png bytes. All fourteen source PNG byte hashes equal this identity and the independent audit records decoded full-RGBA equality. This is a logical Slint snapshot before framebuffer compensation, not native Home, raw framebuffer or optical capture.

Project only public provenance hashes/configuration and stored audit conclusions. Package/ELF/ZIP/payload/fixture archives and admission/log contents are never copied. Their original byte lengths and SHA-256 values come from the frozen independently checked origin manifest. Extract the fixed original-handler path/hash from the frozen driver source; do not claim independent deployed-wrapper source-to-binary requalification. Publish clock C source, record-shell, pinned ELF and private-original archive byte identities only; retain the frozen 28-record mode/mirror chain without original PIDs or executable bytes.

Use explicit report and receipt fields only. Drop command bodies, owner thread, lease token and token digest, process identities, raw registration projection, private transport details and SQLite rows. Aggregate command/query outcomes; preserve all fourteen completed case names. Preserve four selected six-file snapshot SHA values and six public path/content hashes without file inode identities.

Compose an English stored-evidence summary from the frozen results. Exact statistics use the independent audit decimal strings. Do not equate this successful AB timing batch with final product adoption, lifecycle qualification, physical pixels, or a new hardware test.

New minimal public reader of the exported fixed-field case JSON. Adapt only the frozen endpoints() and frame_observation() selection rules plus exact Decimal paired/marginal arithmetic. It does not import the private framework, open archives, contact a device, acquire a lease or execute an application. This is not a copy or independent requalification of the full frozen analyzer.

canonical-analysis-projection.transform: Preserve only these explicit trees. SQLite attempt projections omit stdout/stderr. Native UUID values and structured title JSON are omitted; fixed public identity and null locators are asserted.

clock-record-projection.transform: Preserve original integer clocks only; original record bytes/hash remain separate.

final-state-projection.transform: Preserve listed original final-state fields only; omit account/UI/query/catalog/reader/process values.

identity-only-private-clock.transform: Publish original byte length/hash/mode and public-mirror equality from frozen audit/manifest, not raw private record PID or raw private archive.

lifecycle-record-projection.transform: Keep original record positions; omit process identity, reader state/resources and all account/catalog/download state.

logical-image-original.transform: One original demo/offline logical Slint PNG only; all fourteen byte identities recorded; no native Home or physical framebuffer claim.

performance-record-projection.transform: Keep every native frame and unique ui_ready with original 1-based line positions. Delete process_id/thread_id and all other record/data keys.

recovery-record-projection.transform: Preserve listed original fields; omit application_pid/application_birth.

global_transformations: Only explicit fields are emitted; absent source fields are omitted, not synthesized. Null values remain null.
Raw nanosecond clocks remain integers. Newly derived case endpoint decimals use six fractional places; independent audit exact statistics preserve original decimal strings.
No sample or slower candidate case is discarded, replaced or relabeled. Two warmups stay outside primary six-pair statistics.

Raw native UUIDs, original process/owner identities, lease token values/digests, private transport details, addresses, private account/query/comic-title state and raw archives are excluded; the fixed public product catalog title and demo PNG text remain.
Product/fixture content is not reconstructed. The one admitted image is an original public demo/offline logical Slint snapshot explicitly distinguished from framebuffer and optical evidence.

Source file byte identities are either reread and checked against the frozen manifest or explicitly marked as identity-only references to that manifest; no binary/archive reference implies execution or distribution.
Original independent audit artifacts and the full origin manifest remain frozen and private; this bounded projection gives their source SHA chain without copying complete origin lists.
This export adds no device, lease, application, runtime probe, build, lifecycle, pixel or final product adoption qualification.
source_access: ssh test-env; fixed known stored sources and selected regular archive members in memory only; no private token/transport directory reads or extraction
